description: This file is a shell script used for testing corner cases of the 'git-archive' functionality. It contains setup, precondition checks, and various test cases to verify the behavior of 'git archive' with different formats, sizes, and edge cases.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory and registers a cleanup command to remove it after tests.

methods.name: check_dir
methods.description: Checks that the directory contains exactly the expected set of files and directories.

methods.name: build_tree
methods.description: Generates a tree of file entries with long paths based on a given hash, used to test long path handling.
